text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun conquers the Arima Kinen. 
Her Trainer offers her the promised words: 
"You shone brighter than anyone else out 
there."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the exact words she longed for 
most, Mayano Top Gun burst into tears of 
pure joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Narita Brian's retirement ceremony 
approaching, Mayano Top Gun throws a 
selfish tantrum, begging Narita Brian to 
call off her retirement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun's running grew into 
something so brilliant that it even held 
Narita Brian back from retirement.
